# DocFieldBench dataset card

*Release candidate. The full counts are generated by the build into `DIVERSITY.md` in each release.*

## Summary
260 documents in three tracks, each with a JSON schema and gold for every field, plus 86 scan and photo variants:

| track | documents | what |
|---|---|---|
| Business | 100 | invoices (55), receipts, bank and account statements, delivery notes, payslips |
| Records | 100 | court opinions (48), Federal Register rules (27), SEC 10-Q/10-K cover pages (19) and Form 4s (6) |
| Forms | 60 | US government forms: 40 filled-form images from VAREX (rendered pages, no text layer), 20 filled IRS PDFs |

About one scored field in seven is absent from its document by design (Business 18%, Forms 14%, Records 9%).
Languages: English 207, German 30, Spanish 9, Dutch 9, French 5. Formats: PDF 141, plain text 48, PNG 40, HTML 31.
45 layout families; no family holds more than 6 documents, except the court opinions, which are plain text.

## Composition
Counts by track, source, family, language, format, pages, publication year, absent share and field tags are in
`DIVERSITY.md`, generated by the build.

## Construction
- **Gold provenance:** source markup (embedded e-invoice XML, inline XBRL, programmatic form fills, official
  metadata) or human labels, recorded per field. No gold value comes from a model.
- **Absent fields:** natural (a schema field the document doesn't give) or added from the same document family's
  schemas, each verified absent by searching the document text.
- **Visibility:** every present value is findable in the text it is scored on.
- **Adjudication:** before release, every field where any system disagreed with gold was reviewed blind; the log
  lists each change and its reason.

## Input
Each task is the original document (PDF, PNG/JPEG, HTML or plain text), up to 10 pages. The dataset ships no text, OCR output or
page images: reading the document is part of what is tested. Each single-page born-digital PDF also comes as a scan or a
photo (a seeded draw) with the same gold (`variant_of`); variants are reported by condition and never enter the
headline score. A field printed too small to read after the transform is excluded in that variant.

## Limitations
- Documents up to 10 pages; no long-document track yet.
- Rendered business documents are synthetic records drawn through templates written for this benchmark.
- Filled IRS forms carry synthetic values; Social Security numbers use the never-issued 9xx range.
- English dominates Records and Forms; Business carries the other languages.
- The court opinions are older (2007-2010) and ship as text, not as page images.

## Contamination
- Every file carries the canary string from `docfieldbench/__init__.py`.
- Each document lists its publication date where it has one. 31 documents (the SEC filings and 6 Federal Register
  rules) were published in November 2026, after current models' training cutoffs; each release adds new ones.

## Versioning
Releases are immutable (sha256 per file). Gold fixes go into a new version with a changelog entry.
